featured_reviews.review_text:
Even though we haven’t received all our photos and videos yet, we simply couldn’t stop ourselves from writing this review after seeing just a few results from Shanal Photography and Team. The pictures were so beautiful that we felt compelled to share this feedback immediately!

From the very beginning, Shanal and his team were extremely professional. They arrived on time, dressed professionally, and came fully prepared with all the necessary equipment. Their calm, friendly, and chill attitude made the entire experience so comfortable for us.

What truly stood out was their creativity. They guided us with unique poses, made us feel relaxed, and kept us smiling throughout. In just a few moments, they captured some of the most beautiful pictures. We haven’t even seen the complete outcome yet, but the few photos we saw already left us speechless.

There honestly aren’t enough words to describe the quality, talent, and skill that Shanal and his team bring to their work.

A fun fact — before booking Shanal, I had actually spoken to almost 50 photographers, but none of them truly satisfied me. The moment we met Shanal and saw his work, we knew he was the right choice.

Another very special reason we felt forced to write this review is because of our guests. Literally every single guest who attended our wedding called or messaged us saying the same thing: “We don’t know who your photographer is, but he has done an incredible job. We have never seen such beautiful, unique photos and such quality before.”

It was honestly surprising for us because usually guests compliment the food, venue, or arrangements. But this time, almost everyone only talked about the photography and how impressed they were with Shanal’s work.

And today I can honestly say something I have never felt before — whatever we paid him actually feels less compared to the incredible value and memories he has captured for us.

Another funny moment — after seeing the photos, my husband literally said, “Can we just take Shanal with us everywhere so he can click photos for us whenever we go out?” That’s how impressed we are!

We are truly grateful to Shanal and his entire team for their creativity, professionalism, and beautiful work. We wish him lots of success in the future and hope he continues to receive all the appreciation he truly deserves.
